### December 14, 2024 to January 10, 2025

<details> 

Happy New Year & new notable commits issue everyone!

Over 150+ commits landed in flutter/flutter since the last update in 2024! 🚀
These changes were likely tagged in 3.28.0-2.0.pre.38694 or earlier, and include the monorepo!

We had some pretty significant changes since our last update!

Dart format is now enabled in flutter/flutter!

* **[Michael Goderbauer](https://github.com/goderbauer)** — Auto-format Framework
  <sub>[#160545](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/160545) merged on December 19, 2024 — **Extra large:** [2 comments](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/160545) over 21 hours, 455815 additions and 416698 deletions in 4411 files</sub>
  <sub>Reviewed by: [Kate Lovett](https://github.com/Piinks), [Greg Spencer](https://github.com/gspencergoog)</sub>

Aand…

The engine joined the framework in flutter/flutter! Monorepo & dart format changes bring with them a shared workflow, and easier path to contribute.

This was a huge undertaking, special thanks to:

- [John McDole](https://github.com/jtmcdole)
- [Michael Goderbauer](https://github.com/goderbauer)
- [Yegor Jbanov](https://github.com/yjbanov)

- [Christopher Fujino](https://github.com/christopherfujino)
